message: Node.js 22 (node:22) in Dockerfile can come with npm 10.5.1 to 10.9.9, none of which supports min-release-age (added in 11.10.0), and stage deps installs packages with it on line 6; npm before 11.2.0 ignores settings it does not know without a warning
fix: Add RUN npm install -g npm@11.10.0 to stage deps before it installs packages, or start from a node image whose Node.js release comes with npm 11.10.0 or later (24.14.1 or a later 24.x; 26.0.0 or later), such as node:24.14.1
